test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘polite’ in the given sentence.**

The rude and insensitive murderer pleaded for mercy in the court.
solution: The correct answer is **rude**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Polite: **having good manners and showing respect for others. (सुशील और दूसरों का सम्‍मान करने वाला; नम्र, शिष्‍ट) • **Rude: **not polite. (अशिष्‍ट) • Thus, the most appropriate antonym of the given word is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Pleaded: **to ask somebody for something in a very strong and serious way. (गंभीरतापूर्वक याचना करना, चिरौरी करना) • **Mercy: **kindness shown by somebody/something who has the power to make somebody suffer. (दया, रहम) • **Insensitive: **not able to feel or react to something. (प्रतिक्रियाहीन, वेदनाहीन) 1bf:Tb7b, The correct answer is **how the thieves enter**.
